overview: India Green Grid is a role-based energy decision-support dashboard that unifies India's renewable energy data into dashboards, calculators, and stakeholder portals.
features: Persistent sidebar dashboard shell with a stakeholder role selector
Overview dashboard with KPI cards, energy mix donut and trend charts
Energy mix dashboard with state, year and source filters
RPO compliance tracker with a calculator and configurable policy rates
Rooftop solar ROI calculator with subsidy, payback and CO2 estimates
Green jobs board with search, filters and job detail view
Green finance comparison engine for loans, bonds and government schemes
Circular economy module with recycler directory and traceability form
Environmental impact dashboard with air quality and emissions indicators
Energy forecasting and storage planner with weather panel
Role-based stakeholder portals for five stakeholder groups
Data sources and provenance screen with a pipeline visual
API explorer with sample endpoints and example responses
